body.statement: For a finite rational coefficient encoding \(D\in\mathbb Q[S3]\), the procedure \(\mathcal A_D\) terminates and accepts exactly when \(D\in\mathcal D_{\mathrm{SN},3}\). It rejects before forming \(J_D\) whenever \(D(I3)=0\). On acceptance, the ordered eigenvalues of \(J_D\) are \(a+b+e,b+e,e\), and \(CertD\) contains rational bases for the active spaces, the exponents, \(\lambda_0\), \(c\), and a zero coefficient residual. On rejection, \(CertD\) contains an exact failed guard, a forced nonpositive constant, or a nonzero residual coefficient. No bit-complexity bound is claimed.
body.justification: The finite exact-input contract turns the classification into an auditable recognition and flag-recovery certificate.
body.gap: Tamano's factor-and-rank diagnostic is inconclusive for determinant-free irreducible factors of degree at least three; exact-algebra sources supply operations but no self-normalization classifier.
body.consumer: A symbolic half-trek pipeline can certify the denominator class without altering the primitive reduced fraction.
